scope: The original six-check native suite and all original deadlines remain. Success, failed-read focus restoration and held-read focus migration are verified. Eight originals were individually viewed at original dimensions and matched by SHA-256. Six light/dark Electron zoom rings include their outline offset within the scroll viewport. The final two-file standalone parser overlay additionally rejects coerced string measurements; the product and native harness match the stable native snapshot. Full desktop, new-package installation, physical input, Windows DPI and complete reference adoption remain separate.
